correctness.rationale: For the stated left-to-right transitions, distinct live tokens never merge at nonzero states. Each of the k+m initial tokens needs its own kill; each cycle decreases the live high count by at most one. The exhibited word attains k+2m by clearing low positions and then rotating and killing high tokens in increasing initial order. At equality every cycle demotes one live token and does not promote a token from position k. Before cycle j, if the token originally at k-j+1 survives it has been incremented j−1 times (each cycle starts at ≤m≤k−m+1), so it occupies k and the gate kill is necessary. For sufficiency, initial low tokens ≤k−m can have advanced by at most j−1; the gate tokens with index k−r+1 for r≤j have been killed and those with r>j are still below k. A previously demoted high token starts at ≤m and can advance by at most j−2, so it lies below k since m+j−2≤2m−2≤k−1. Thus the chosen high token determines a legal rotating letter and each kill determines a unique letter. Reading the resulting string reproduces the token events, proving distinctness and exhaustion. Conditioning independent arrival times on the cycle times u_h, the distinct gate constraints have probability product u_h and the distinct subsequent kills probability product (1−u_h), giving 6^(−m). This includes m=k=1 and the tight boundary k=2m−1. Fresh independent reverse subset-graph computation, preserving parallel labeled arcs and counting shortest paths from the empty live set, verified counts 1, 4, 140, 184800, 1009008000, 15643660032000 at (k,m)=(1,1),(2,1),(3,2),(5,3),(7,4),(9,5), and 16 at the excluded (2,2).
residual_risks: The reverse-graph reproduction and the supplied forward-graph evidence are bounded cross-checks. The proof, not the computations, establishes the characterization at unbounded parameter values. No general count below k=2m−1 is reviewed.

value.rationale: A closed count of optimal words measures how many choices remain at the minimum reset length in an established family. A researcher can use the event characterization to generate or recognize every optimal schedule without enumerating the subset automaton. The nontrivial gating constraints and probability factorization are explanatory rather than a table or repetition of the known threshold.
residual_risks: The result describes optimal words only, not all resetting words or optimum adversarial-game strategies.
